seo.title: Compliance Dashboard
seo.description: Case volume, pending reviews, and recent submissions across your organization.

welcome.title: Welcome to Compliance
welcome.content: This sidebar is where you navigate between your dashboard and all reports.

stats.title: Case overview
stats.content: Track total, pending, active, and resolved reports at a glance — click a card to open that slice of the list.

allReports.title: All reports
allReports.content: Browse, filter, and open every report submitted to your organization.

recent.title: Recent submissions
recent.content: The newest reports land here first — click any row to open the case.

category.title: Reports by category
category.content: See how reports break down by type, so you can spot trends quickly.

account.title: Your account
account.content: Manage your profile or log out from here.

seo.title: Admin Dashboard
seo.description: Platform-wide reporting activity, user counts, and category analytics.

welcome.title: Welcome, Admin
welcome.content: This sidebar is your control center for managing the whole platform.

stats.title: Platform overview
stats.content: A snapshot of total reports, active users, pending cases, and anonymous submissions — click any card to open the matching, pre-filtered list.

filters.title: Filter the period
filters.content: Narrow every figure on this page to a date range and interval, then press Apply.

allReports.title: All reports
allReports.content: Review every report submitted across the organization.

users.title: User management
users.content: Create, edit, and deactivate user accounts.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.content: Build your organization's roles and choose what each one is allowed to do.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.content: Define the AI agents that triage and summarize incoming reports, and what each may do.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.content: Choose the stages a new report runs through, and where an agent hands over to a person.

categories.title: Reports by category
categories.content: See which report types are driving volume over the selected period. Click a category to list its reports.

distribution.title: Category distribution
distribution.content: The same breakdown as a share of the total — click a slice to drill into that category.

account.title: Your account
account.content: Manage your profile or log out from here.

distribution.title: Category distribution

stats.content: Track total, pending, active, and resolved reports assigned to you.

allReports.content: Browse and open every report you have access to review.

help.title: Help & Support
help.content: Have a question? Find guidance and support resources here.
